source_pinning.rule: The source is only what root's build-ready.json grants: a 40-hex commit object (never a branch name) and root's source freeze by absolute path and SHA-256. build.py exports that commit with git archive (blob-verified; no working-tree or dirty file can enter). If the freeze names a head/commit/source_commit it must equal the granted commit. Its rows (files, sources, unchanged_baselines or baselines; path, sha256, optional bytes) must cover every build input exactly: the same set of paths under build_inputs, each with the same SHA-256 and size; every other freeze row must exist in the commit and match too. Any mismatch latches stop.

builds.note: Default features only: this review is the portable WGSL path. A cooked-* (including cooked-temporal) or native-metalfx feature in the build refuses the stage before any GPU child; those routes need their own same-source grants.

policy.note: Fixed review policy, identical to the 0072 fixed-resolution review; there is no preset. Unchanged by revision 1.

probe.purpose: Adapter and backend; the owner refuses before the startup opt-in; opt-in succeeds and is idempotent; the review policy validates and five invalid policies are refused by validation and by the owner; logical owner footprint recorded as context only.

stationary.purpose: Static look-dev stage. FULL output-size control and DRS 8/16 nearest control (each with the physical UI), then 24 UP 8/16 frames: three 8-phase jitter cycles, UI on the last 8. Thin detail (1.6, 0.8 and 0.4 px wires and a 0.56 px diagonal against the backdrop; posts receding to about 1.3 px), a trilinear-mipmapped chart at about one texel per output pixel, sphere and cube silhouettes, sun shadows, a BLEND card, nearest-sampled sprites and world text.

motion.purpose: The stage plus a cube: 8 static UP frames, then the cube moves 0.12 m (about 8 px) per frame out from behind the sphere across the chart (occlusion and disocclusion), and from frame 15 the camera also pans 0.05 m per frame. FULL and DRS controls render frames 14 and 20 exactly.

transitions.purpose: The stage in a fractional, offset, rounded viewport. FULL and DRS 8/16 controls, then UP: 10 frames at 8/16, internal-only changes to 12, 4, 16 and 8 sixteenths (3 frames each, one owner and history throughout), then an explicit cut and 5 frames at 8/16.

counting: A frame is one queue submission that renders into a 960x540 review target: every RetainedScene::submit attempt, including refusals and failures, and every UiLayer::submit. Readback copies are part of their frame. The helper charges each frame before attempting it and panics past its case limit; gpu.py debits each case's full reserve under the packet and shared GPU locks, fsyncs it and only then launches. Debits are never refunded, and a failed case ends the stage.
contract_checks_only: Pass/fail comes from the plan's exact contract checks per case (submitted-owner phase, history, epoch, sequence, internal and output size; control identity; opaque UI interior identity; viewport chrome identity; non-blank frames) and from analyze.py's integrity comparisons. None depends on the reconstruction math changed in the corrected source. Image metrics are observations; appearance is judged only by inspecting the PNGs.
corrected_contract_expectations: Read-only at 9a65b6c8: history now renormalizes over supporting previous taps instead of refusing when any positive tap is outside or incompatible; BLEND models, sprites and world text draw with the unjittered camera over a re-rasterized unjittered opaque depth, and the composite samples them on the unjittered internal grid; the current-coverage edge policy is unchanged. These are expectations to verify visually, never inferred from a numeric pass.
